beginner.title: Get started with Windows voice typing
beginner.outcome: You can: set up Windows voice typing, find your way around and finish a first small task
beginner.practice: Complete the official getting-started guide, then one small real task from your work

beginner.title: Turn it on and set it up
beginner.outcome: You can: start using Windows voice typing
beginner.practice: Set up Windows voice typing for your needs

beginner.title: Everyday tasks
beginner.outcome: You can: use Windows voice typing for daily tasks
beginner.practice: Complete three daily tasks with Windows voice typing

intermediate.title: Customise
intermediate.outcome: You can: tailor Windows voice typing to you

intermediate.title: Work and study
intermediate.outcome: You can: use Windows voice typing at work or school
intermediate.practice: Use Windows voice typing in one meeting or class

intermediate.title: Signature skills in Windows voice typing
intermediate.outcome: You can: use the features that make Windows voice typing distinctive
intermediate.practice: Use each of these features once on a real piece of work

expert.title: Advanced Windows voice typing
expert.outcome: You can: use Windows voice typing's advanced capabilities with confidence
expert.practice: Complete a project that needs at least two of these advanced capabilities

expert.title: Support and advocate
expert.outcome: You can: help others and test accessibility
expert.practice: Test a document or website with Windows voice typing

expert.title: Integrate Windows voice typing into your workflow
expert.outcome: You can: connect Windows voice typing with the other tools you use
expert.practice: Connect Windows voice typing to one other tool you use and remove one manual step

expert.title: Lead and teach others
expert.outcome: You can: set standards and teach others to use Windows voice typing well
expert.practice: Write a one-page "how we use Windows voice typing" guide and teach it to one person

expert_validation.note: Generated from the archetype template plus tool-specific signature skills; to be reviewed by a practitioner.
